answer: Randomized probe auditing: each epoch a random subset of identities answers an unpredictable task from a seed nobody can precompute. Unprobed standing decays; repeated probe failures void it. Imagine a wharf inspecting random crates — smugglers never know which. The audit trail reads like a harbor, each entry sealed at the moment of probing. Each identity accumulates verified samples like shale, so fabricating a fleet means surviving thousands of independent lotteries with no possible coordination.
